title: pr-lens workflow: provider fallback and lens retry
summary: The pr-lens GitHub Actions workflow gains a fifth column in its provider table (temperature), a new PR_LENS_OPENAI_MODEL repository variable, and a skip path for OpenAI when a key exists but no model is configured. The analyze step is restructured around a try_provider helper that attempts each provider with both lenses first and then with the architecture lens alone, so a long data-flow answer that fails validation no longer costs the whole diagram. Failure notes now carry the skipped-provider reason alongside the per-provider failure reasons.

nodes.label: Pull request event
nodes.subtitle: opened / synchronize
nodes.summary: The GitHub event that starts the workflow; unchanged by this diff.

nodes.label: Repository variables
nodes.subtitle: PR_LENS_PROVIDER, PR_LENS_MODEL, PR_LENS_OPENAI_MODEL
nodes.summary: Repository-level configuration read by the workflow. This change adds PR_LENS_OPENAI_MODEL, the only way to give the openai row a model, since that row has no default.

nodes.label: Repository secrets
nodes.subtitle: DEEPSEEK / OPENAI / ANTHROPIC keys
nodes.summary: The API keys that decide which provider rows are eligible. Unchanged, but now a key without a model is not enough for openai.

nodes.label: Resolve the model providers
nodes.subtitle: steps.provider
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered provider table and emits first_/second_ outputs. Now reads a fifth temperature column, consults OPENAI_MODEL for the openai row, and records a skipped note when openai has a key but no model.

nodes.label: Provider table
nodes.subtitle: cli | base url | model | key var | temperature
nodes.summary: The case statement mapping provider name to its CLI provider, base URL, default model, key variable and temperature. deepseek and anthropic now pin temperature 0; openai asks for the provider default because reasoning models reject a fixed temperature.

nodes.label: OpenAI skip guard
nodes.subtitle: skipped="openai: skipped, no model configured"
nodes.summary: New branch: when the openai row has a key but still no model after the override and OPENAI_MODEL checks, the row is skipped and the reason is written to the skipped output instead of silently vanishing.

nodes.label: List the changed files
nodes.subtitle: steps.files
nodes.summary: Decides whether the diff is docs-only and therefore whether any model call happens at all.

nodes.label: Analyze the diff
nodes.subtitle: steps.analyze
nodes.summary: Drives the CLI attempts. Now delegates each provider to try_provider, which tries both lenses then architecture alone, and appends the skipped note to the final failure reason.

nodes.label: try_provider
nodes.subtitle: both lenses, then --lens architecture
nodes.summary: New helper: runs attempt with no lens flag, and on failure clears the partial graph and retries with --lens architecture. Returns 0 if either draws, and accumulates the reason text when neither does.

nodes.label: attempt
nodes.subtitle: npx @coldtea/pr-lens-cli@0.13.0 analyze
nodes.summary: The single CLI invocation. Now takes temperature as a fifth positional argument, always passes --temperature, and forwards any extra flags such as --lens architecture.

nodes.label: No usable model note
nodes.subtitle: section.md
nodes.summary: The comment written when no provider produced a diagram. It now appends the skipped note, so a reader learns that openai was skipped for lack of a model rather than for lack of a key.

nodes.label: Failure note
nodes.subtitle: analyze-reason.txt
nodes.summary: The reason file consumed by the follow-up note step. It now concatenates the per-provider reasons with the skipped note.

nodes.label: pr-lens CLI
nodes.subtitle: @coldtea/pr-lens-cli 0.11.0 → 0.13.0
nodes.summary: The analyzer invoked via npx. The pinned version moves from 0.11.0 to 0.13.0, which is what makes the --temperature flag and the --lens flag meaningful.

nodes.label: DeepSeek API
nodes.subtitle: api.deepseek.com, deepseek-chat
nodes.summary: OpenAI-compatible endpoint used as the default provider. Its row now carries temperature 0.

nodes.label: OpenAI API
nodes.subtitle: no default model, temperature default
nodes.summary: The openai row has no default model and now asks the CLI to send no fixed temperature, because reasoning models reject one. It is only attempted when a model is configured.

nodes.label: Anthropic API
nodes.subtitle: api.anthropic.com/v1, claude-sonnet-5
nodes.summary: OpenAI-compatible endpoint used as the last fallback. Its row now carries temperature 0.

flows.title: Provider selection and lens fallback
flows.summary: How a pull request event becomes a diagram: the provider table is resolved from keys and variables, each candidate is tried with both lenses and then architecture alone, and the first success ends the run.

messages.label: validation failed
messages.note: A long data-flow answer is the likelier to fail validation, which is why the retry drops to one lens.

messages.label: try_provider SECOND_*
messages.note: Only reached when the first provider failed both ways.
